thread:
tara.sales: FYI - Prospect HaloHealth asks for SOC2 excerpt, signed pen-test attestation, and ephemeral KMS creds for their auditors to run a quick external scan during POC. Can SE/security give feasibility and timeline?
anya.se: Feasible. We can provide ephemeral staging creds + presigned upload. Need to confirm outbound egress and whether they want Dedicated KMS isolation.
lucas.sec: From security: pen-test attestation template ready but we require their signer details. For KMS: Private deployments with customer-managed KMS/HSM are supported but provisioning ephemeral keys requires KMS owner approval and a 1-page runbook.
tara.sales: They're pushing for EOW delivery. Can we turn around SOC2 redacted snapshot + pen-test draft by Friday?
eden.pm: I'll prepare a minimal artifact set. Lucas - confirm what to redact from SOC2.
lucas.sec: Standard redaction: strip internal IPs, internal hostnames, and service account emails. I'll drop the redaction checklist. evidence-bot: SOC2 snapshot (redacted) uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/soc2/halo-2026-04-01.zip
anya.se: For ephemeral KMS we need (1) allowed staging CIDR(s), (2) desired key rotation policy/time window. Note Dedicated single-tenant KMS impacts quote.
tara.sales: CIDRs provided in the prospect email. I'll ask about rotation window and signer name. Please add Dedicated KMS delta to the quote.
anya.se: Tentative cost bump: Dedicated + KMS isolation = +$3,200/month (estimate). Final after infra review.
lucas.sec: If they insist on independent third-party pen-test proof (vs our attestation) add ~2 weeks to timeline.
eden.pm: Evidence checklist I'm assembling: SOC2 redacted report, minimal network diagram, pen-test attestation draft, KMS keyflow diagram, presigned upload snippet, ephemeral creds runbook.
tara.sales: Presigned example for their engineering team?
anya.se: Example: ```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/halo-poc.zip --expires-in 3600
```
lucas.sec: Security guidance: expiry <=1h, single-use logging, include request_id in audit record.
tara.sales: They also asked whether attestation can mention support for on-prem HSM. Safe to include that?
lucas.sec: Yes — language allowed: "Redwood supports Private deployments with customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations." Do not claim specific vendor compatibility unless validated.
eden.pm: I'll upload the bundle and loop Legal for a quick sign-off on the attestation wording. evidence-bot: Pen-test-attestation-template_v2.docx uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/templates/pen-test-attestation_v2.docx
tara.sales: Thanks — I'll send the package to HaloHealth and request signer info. Will update here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
